items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 72:1
items.html: The screen in the vessel of Malchut is called Sitra ('a concealment'), because it delimits and covers the lights. And since a new screen of the aspect of the Malchut of the second restriction was added in Atzilut, it follows that Atik emanated Arich Anpin in the aspect of a concealment within a concealment: besides its own Sitra, from the aspect of the Malchut of the first restriction, it added another Sitra of the Malchut of the second restriction. Thus Arich Anpin is bounded by two aspects of screens, which are discerned as a concealment within a concealment. (Page 297, Item 1).
